what: one candidate replacement for efv_dataset._label_6yr's flat-rate tail projection: a FORWARD-CHAINED per-season-index share profile, scored on held-out truncation error against the shipped projection, a rank-identical level twin, two nulls, a sign-flip permutation test and a one-parameter scalar-fit control
candidate: candidate_target(n) = obs_sum / S_n, S_n = cumulative share of six-year WAR mass through season index n, estimated on STRICTLY PRIOR debut cohorts. Shipped is the special case S_n = n/6.

thresholds_added_by_this_lane.chosen_from: row counts only, before any error number existed
thresholds_added_by_this_lane.gate_1: DELTA_MSE CI95 upper < 0 in n2_hit under BOTH E_cond and E_refit
thresholds_added_by_this_lane.gate_2: DELTA_MSE vs level twin CI95 upper < 0 in n2_hit under BOTH
thresholds_added_by_this_lane.gate_5: >=4 of 8 family cells CI95 upper < 0 under E_cond AND >=2 Holm significant

bootstrap.seed_provenance: inherited from B1, fixed before the run

pin_check.note: lambda pinned; a synthetic label beside an unpinned lambda would silently move the served blend. This lab changes no lambda and fits nothing.

pooled_vs_perside_profile.note: if the CI covers zero the pooled profile is estimable without per-side thinning; the pooled arm stays primary either way per gate doc part 1

multiplicity.note: the 4 pooled-side cells are reported but are not counted into the family

label_space_rank_diagnostic.what: Spearman between the SHIPPED and CANDIDATE censored targets over the shipped rows that ride the projection. LABEL SPACE ONLY. This is NOT a served-board rank delta: no refit was run, per gate doc part 7.

profile_used.source: all 988 resolved rows (what production would estimate on)

label_space_rank_diagnostic.terminal_note: window arithmetic marks these debuted rows censored, but the shipped matrices resolve them via efv_dataset's career-terminal transaction rule (retirement or lifetime ban), weight 1.0, observed_seasons 6. They do NOT ride the projection and are excluded here. Excluding them reproduces B1's 833.
label_space_rank_diagnostic.spearman_within_span_note: 1.0 by construction within any fixed span: both are positive scalar multiples of obs_sum. All movement is cross-span.
label_space_rank_diagnostic.economic_bound: deleting the ENTIRE censored pitcher block, the maximum perturbation any label instrument in this program can cause, moves the served board by rho 0.9441; nothing here can exceed that

post_hoc_not_preregistered._status: POST HOC. Not in the pre-registration. Computed after the run, appended after all pre-registered draws. Gates nothing. This lane's verdict is about the CANDIDATE and does not depend on this block.
post_hoc_not_preregistered.what: level twin (shipped + forward-chained constant) versus SHIPPED

ship_recommendation: NO LABEL CHANGE SHIPPED. This lane writes no shipped code by design.
